name: The Expanse
description: A thriller set two hundred years in the future following the case of a missing young woman who brings a hardened detective and a rogue ship's captain together in a race across the solar system to expose the greatest conspiracy in human history.

Introducing The Expanse Aftershow with Wes Chatham and Ty Franck of James S.A. Corey
videos.overview: Ty Franck (Executive Producer & Co-Writer; one half of James S.A. Corey) and Wes Chatham (Lead Actor; Amos Burton) are teaming up to bring you The Expanse Aftershow.

videos.title: The Expanse Aftershow S5E1 "Exodus" – Wes Chatham, Ty Franck, & Naren Shankar
videos.overview: In the inaugural episode of the official The Expanse Aftershow with Ty & That Guy, Ty Franck and Wes Chatham welcome Executive Producer & Showrunner, Naren Shankar, to chat through how they adapted Nemesis Games to Season 5, The Churn, and what the hell a showrunner does.

videos.title: The Expanse Aftershow S5E2 "Churn" – Wes Chatham, Ty Franck, Steven Strait, & Breck Eisner
videos.overview: Steven Strait (Lead Actor & Producer) and Breck Eisner (Director) join Wes Chatham and Ty Franck on this episode of the official The Expanse After show to discuss the contentious relationship between writer and director, insulting Steven Spielberg, the concept of family for Belters, capturing Baltimore in a totally uncomplicated way, and the once-a-season Simpsons easter egg.

videos.title: The Expanse Aftershow S5E3 "Mother" – Wes Chatham, Ty Franck, and Thomas Jane
videos.overview: In this installment of The Expanse Aftershow, Ty and Wes sit down with Thomas Jane, a man who wears many hats—that's not a Miller joke, he directed Episode 3 in Season 5! Watch them break down Thomas' new role as a director, diverting from the scripts, and the impact of seeing Alien (1979) as children.

videos.title: The Expanse Aftershow S5E4 "Gaugamela" – Wes Chatham, Ty Franck, Shohreh Aghdashloo, and Dan Nowak
videos.overview: All hail Queen of the Earth herself on this installment of The Expanse Aftershow! Shohreh Aghdashloo aka Chrisjen Avasarala and EP & Writer Dan Nowak join Wes Chatham and Ty Franck to discuss what convinced Shohreh to join The Expanse, Amos' survival instincts, and Under Siege (1992) references.

videos.title: The Expanse Aftershow S5E5 "Down and Out" – Wes Chatham, Ty Franck, Jasai Chase Owens & Jeff Woolnough
videos.overview: This week, Ty Franck and Wes Chatham welcome one of the longest standing crew members and one of the newest to The Expanse Aftershow. Watch Jeff Woolnough, director of episode S5E5 "Down and Out", and Jasai Chase Owens, who plays Filip, join the chat to discuss the latest episode of The Expanse Season 5.

videos.title: The Expanse Aftershow S5E6 "Tribes" – Wes Chatham, Ty Franck, Cara Gee & Keon Alexander
videos.overview: The awesome Cara Gee (Camina Drummer) and the okay Keon Alexander (Marco Inaros) join hosts Wes Chatham and Ty Franck in this week's installment of The Expanse Aftershow to cover episode S5E6 "Tribes".

videos.title: The Expanse Aftershow S5E7 "Oyedeng" – Wes Chatham, Ty Franck & Dominique Tipper
videos.overview: On this week’s installment of The Expanse Aftershow, Dominique Tipper (Naomi Nagata) jumps in with Ty Franck and Wes Chatham to discuss Naomi’s long-awaited backstory and episode S5E7 "Oyedeng".

videos.title: The Expanse Aftershow S5E8 "Hard Vacuum" – Wes Chatham, Ty Franck & Daniel Abraham
videos.overview: Both halves of James S.A. Corey are in the house (remotely) to dive into episode S5E8 "Hard Vacuum" in this week's The Expanse Aftershow. Daniel Abraham reveals to Wes Chatham how he and Ty Franck met, the writing process behind The Expanse novels, and his favorite shows.

videos.title: The Expanse Aftershow S5E9 "Winnipesaukee" – Wes Chatham, Ty Franck & Nadine Nicole
videos.overview: Hope everyone is ready for a full serving of Peaches. This week's special guest on The Expanse Aftershow is none other than Nadine Nicole (Clarissa Mao) to take us through episode S5E9 "Winnipesaukee" with hosts Wes Chatham and Ty Franck.

videos.title: The Expanse Aftershow S5E10 "Nemesis Games" – Wes Chatham, Ty Franck, Dominique Tipper & Steven Strait
videos.overview: Ty Franck and Wes Chatham reunite the Roci crew to talk about the season finale S5E10 "Nemesis Games"! For the last episode of The Expanse Aftershow, Dominique Tipper (Naomi Nagata) and Steven Strait (Jim Holden) join Ty & That Guy to walk through the Season 5 finale and “one of the most powerful visual sequences in all of The Expanse.".

videos.title: The Expanse Aftershow S6E1 "Strange Dogs" – Wes Chatham, Ty Franck w/ Naren Shankar, Daniel Abraham & Breck Eisner
videos.overview: In the first installment of The Expanse Season 6’s Aftershow, Ty Franck and Wes Chatham welcome Executive Producer & Showrunner, Naren Shankar, Executive Producer and Co-Writer, Daniel Abraham, and Director, Breck Eisner, to discuss S6E1 "Strange Dogs".

videos.title: The Expanse Aftershow S6E2 "Azure Dragon" – Wes Chatham & Ty Franck w/ Frankie Adams & Nadine Nicole
videos.overview: In this episode of The Expanse Season 6’s Aftershow, Ty Franck and Wes Chatham welcome lead actors Frankie Adams and Nadine Nicole to discuss S6E2 "Azure Dragon".

videos.title: The Expanse Aftershow S6E3 "Force Projection" – Wes Chatham & Ty Franck w/ Keon Alexander
videos.overview: In this episode of The Expanse Season 6’s Aftershow, Ty Franck and Wes Chatham welcome lead actor Keon Alexander to discuss S6E3 "Force Projection".

videos.title: The Expanse Aftershow S6E4 "Redoubt" – Wes Chatham & Ty Franck w/ Dan Nowak
videos.overview: In the 4th episode of The Expanse Season 6’s Aftershow, Ty Franck and Wes Chatham welcome writer Dan Nowak to discuss S6E4 "Redoubt".

videos.title: The Expanse Aftershow S6E5 "Why We Fight" – Wes Chatham & Ty Franck w/ Shohreh Aghdashloo & Cara Gee
videos.overview: In the 5th episode of The Expanse Season 6’s Aftershow, Ty Franck and Wes Chatham welcome lead actors Shohreh Aghdashloo and Cara Gee to discuss S6E5 "Why We Fight".

videos.title: The Expanse Aftershow S6E6 "Babylon's Ashes" – Wes Chatham & Ty Franck w/ Dominique Tipper & Steven Strait
videos.overview: In the final episode of The Expanse Season 6’s Aftershow, Ty Franck and Wes Chatham welcome lead actors Dominique Tipper and Steven Strait to discuss S6E6 "Babylon's Ashes".

videos.title: Dulcinea
videos.overview: In the outer solar system near Saturn, James Holden and the crew of the ice-freighter Canterbury, investigate a distress call from a mysterious derelict ship, the Scopuli. On Ceres Station, Detective Miller begins an off the book investigation of a missing heiress, Julie Mao.

videos.title: The Big Empty
videos.overview: Holden and crew are trapped in badly damaged shuttle. On Ceres, Miller uncovers clues about Julie Mao. On Earth, Chrisjen Avasarala questions a terrorist.

videos.title: Remember the Cant
videos.overview: Holden and the crew are taken prisoner by the Martian Congressional Republic Navy. Miller deals with unhappy rioters. Avasarala plays politics and gets severely burned.

videos.title: CQB
videos.overview: Holden and crew find themselves in the middle of a desperate battle while still aboard the Martian battleship. Miller’s partner, Havelock, goes missing.

videos.title: Back to the Butcher
videos.overview: Holden finds an unlikely ally. Miller’s obsession with Mao intensifies.

videos.title: Rock Bottom
videos.overview: Miller gains valuable information from a hidden data cube. Holden and his crew learn their host’s agenda.

videos.title: Windmills
videos.overview: Holden and his crew face a Martian military blockade. Miller finds a new reason to forge ahead. Avasarala visits Holden’s family.

videos.title: Salvage
videos.overview: A derelict vessel holds a potentially devastating secret. Holden and his crew cross paths with Miller on Eros. Avasarala receives bad news.

videos.title: Critical Mass
videos.overview: Julie's origin story ends up revealing her trajectory. Holden and Miller work together as they take a look at a strange emergency happening on Eros.

videos.title: Leviathan Wakes
videos.overview: Avasarala uncovers a game-changing secret while the future of the human race might be in Holden and Miller's hands.

videos.title: Safe
videos.overview: Unlikely allies Joe Miller and the crew of the Rocinante led by Jim Holden uncover more about the conspiracy to release the protomolecule on Eros station.

videos.title: Doors & Corners
videos.overview: With the help of Fred Johnson and the OPA, Miller, Holden and the crew stage a raid for information on the protomolecule. On Earth, Avasarala learns a truth about Fred Johnson.

videos.title: Static
videos.overview: Holden and Miller butt heads about how the raid was handled.

videos.title: Godspeed
videos.overview: Miller devises a dangerous plan to eradicate what's left of the protomolecule on Eros.

videos.title: Home
videos.overview: The Rocinante chases an asteroid as it hurtles towards Earth.

videos.title: Paradigm Shift
videos.overview: Earth and Mars search for answers in the aftermath of the asteroid collision.

videos.title: The Seventh Man
videos.overview: Preparations for the Earth/Mars peace conference tighten the tension on Erringwright.

videos.title: Pyre
videos.overview: Naomi tracks down signs of the protomolecule; Fred Johnson's control over the OPA collapses.

videos.title: The Weeping Somnambulist
videos.overview: Bobbie becomes a political pawn in the struggle between Earth and Mars.

videos.title: Cascade
videos.overview: Holden leads his crew through the war-torn station on Ganymede.

videos.title: Here There Be Dragons
videos.overview: Bobbie makes a decision that changes her life forever.

videos.title: The Monster and the Rocket
videos.overview: A discovery pushes Naomi and Holden apart and sets the Rocinante crew against each other.

videos.title: Caliban's War
videos.overview: The Rocinante crew must fight to save the ship.

videos.title: Fight or Flight
videos.overview: The Rocinante crew deals with the fallout over Naomi's betrayal while caught in the middle of the war between Earth and Mars. Meanwhile, Avasarala and Bobbie hatch an escape plan.

videos.title: IFF
videos.overview: The Rocinante answers an unexpected distress signal. Bobbie and Avasarala find themselves being hunted by a mysterious captor. UN Secretary-General Sorrento-Gillis brings in a colleague from his past to lend an ear during this crucial time of war.

videos.title: Assured Destruction
videos.overview: As Earth strategizes a costly ploy to gain advantage in the war against Mars, Anna struggles to convince Sorrento-Gillis to do the right thing. Avasarala and Bobbie seek refuge aboard the Rocinante.

videos.title: Reload
videos.overview: The Rocinante tends to wounded Martian soldiers in exchange for supplies. Avasarala struggles with how to disseminate a key piece of evidence despite being in hiding.

videos.title: Triple Point
videos.overview: The search for Prax's daughter comes to a head. Admiral Souther's men plan for mutiny aboard the Agatha King

videos.title: Immolation
videos.overview: The final battle between Earth and Mars threatens the very future of humanity. A new monster is unleashed on Prospero Station. Anna receives the smoking gun she needs.

videos.title: Delta-V
videos.overview: All eyes turn to the edge of the solar system as a mysterious new presence emerges; Naomi recommits to her roots; Drummer butts heads with a seasoned new commander aboard the Behemoth; and a young Belter makes a name for himself.

videos.title: It Reaches Out
videos.overview: An old friend taunts Holden with the answers he seeks. Naomi struggles to fit in. A mysterious low-level tech aboard the Thomas Prince enacts a terrifying plan.

videos.title: Intransigence
videos.overview: The Rocinante seeks a new gameplan as they attempt to avoid capture. Melba's true motives are revealed. Naomi is torn between identity and ideal. Anna seeks a way to stay aboard the Thomas Prince.

videos.title: Dandelion Sky
videos.overview: Holden sees past, present, and future. A ghost from Melba's past threatens her mission. Bobbie struggles to trust an old friend as she leads a group into unchartered territory.

videos.title: Fallen World
videos.overview: Drummer and Ashford find themselves trapped with few options for survival; Anna tends to the wounded masses as Melba continues to hunt down her prey; the Rocinante crew struggles to survive as Naomi reunites with her true family.

videos.title: Congregation
videos.overview: As survivors arrive at the Behemoth, two factions form over how to handle a life-or-death threat. Holden grapples with what he's seen and the choices he must make.

videos.title: Abaddon's Gate
videos.overview: Holden and his allies must stop Ashford and his team from destroying the Ring, and perhaps all of humanity.

videos.title: New Terra
videos.overview: The crew of the Roci investigates a strange protomolecule ruin on an alien planet. Bobbie copes with civilian life on Mars. Drummer and Ashford battle with piracy in the Belt.

videos.title: Jetsam
videos.overview: Avasarala is blindsided while on a visit to Mars. The Roci crew continue their protomolecule investigation while tensions between the RCE and Belters reach a tipping point. Drummer and Ashford track down a terrorist.

videos.title: Subduction
videos.overview: New alien threats emerge on Ilus as Naomi battles health challenges on the planet. Bobbie searches for a missing person on Mars. Avasarala faces a new challenge in the UN.

videos.title: Retrograde
videos.overview: Drummer and Ashford confront a dangerous person from Naomi's past. Murtry hunts down a target. Bobbie's makes a life-changing confession.

videos.title: Oppressor
videos.overview: As tensions on Ilus reach a boiling point, Holden reveals a secret. Avasarala debates Nancy Gao while an emergency on the Roci forces Alex and Naomi into action.

videos.title: Displacement
videos.overview: The Roci crew prepares for an incoming disaster on Ilus. Ashford and Drummer close in on an enemy within the Belt. Bobbie takes on a dangerous job.

videos.title: A Shot in the Dark
videos.overview: Naomi and Alex work to keep the Barbapiccola in orbit amidst a power outage. Avasarala faces a tough decision. Holden and Elvi race to find a cure for a disease spreading on Ilus.

videos.title: The One-Eyed Man
videos.overview: Avasarala faces fallout for the UN's military mission. Ashford and Drummer makes big decisions about their future within the OPA. A spreading illness on Ilus takes a toll on Amos. Alex and Naomi's attempt to rescue the Barb turns desperate.

videos.title: Saeculum
videos.overview: Holden and Miller race to save Ilus. Murtry puts his endgame into motion, putting the Roci crew's lives at risk.

videos.title: Cibola Burn
videos.overview: Ashford closes in on an enemy while uncovering a dangerous plot. Avasarala faces a crossroads in her personal and political life. The Roci crew works to reestablish life on Ilus in the wake of a deadly catastrophe.

videos.title: Exodus
videos.overview: Holden tries to convince Fred Johnson to destroy the last sample of protomolecule. Naomi gets an important lead to her son. On Luna, Avasarala begins to hunt for Marco Inaros.

videos.title: Churn
videos.overview: Holden and Fred deal with infiltrators on Tycho. Drummer's past comes back to haunt her. Amos returns to Baltimore. Alex and Bobbie's investigation on Mars leads to rogue soldiers.

videos.title: Mother
videos.overview: Naomi comes face to face with Filip. Holden and Fred turn the tables. Avasarala closes in on Marco's plot.

videos.title: Gaugamela
videos.overview: Marco's grand plan shocks Earth, Mars and the Belt.

videos.title: Down and Out
videos.overview: Amos and Clarissa are trapped in a collapsed building. Naomi contends with her old family. Holden assembles a new crew on the Roci. Alex and Bobbie make a dangerous discovery in the Belt.

videos.title: Tribes
videos.overview: Holden and the Roci go on the hunt. Amos and Clarissa seek shelter on a devastated Earth. Bobbie and Alex fight a desperate battle. Marco makes Drummer an offer she can't refuse. Avasarala returns to a position of power.

videos.title: Oyedeng
videos.overview: Naomi makes a desperate attempt to save her son from Marco. On the Roci, Holden battles for the last sample of protomolecule.

videos.title: Hard Vacuum
videos.overview: Amos returns to Baltimore with Clarissa. On Luna, Avasarala's alliances begin to shift. Alone and adrift, Naomi becomes a deadly lure.

videos.title: Winnipesaukee
videos.overview: Amos, Clarissa, and a gang of thieves work together to leave Earth. Avasarala tries to head off a brutal military strike. Drummer's new family bonds are tested as Naomi's life hangs in the balance.

videos.title: Nemesis Games
videos.overview: Holden and the Roci face off against Marco's forces and Drummer, while Alex and Bobbie attempt a dangerous rescue of Naomi, and the balance of power in the Solar System shifts.

videos.title: Strange Dogs
videos.overview: The Rocinante crew make a startling discovery on an asteroid. Avasarala and Bobbie contend with the devastation on Earth. Drummer and her family must make a heartbreaking decision. On Ceres, Marco and Filip's struggles turn inward.

videos.title: Azure Dragon
videos.overview: With an unexpected passenger aboard the Rocinante, Holden and crew undertake a dangerous mission that could shift the balance of power in the war. Drummer decides to make an uneasy alliance. Filip wrestles with his guilt.

videos.title: Force Projection
videos.overview: Avasarala, with the Combined Fleet of Earth and Mars, takes the war to Marco. Filip and Marco's relationship is tested. The war becomes more perilous and personal for Holden and Naomi when the Rocinante is suddenly forced into a battle.

videos.title: Redoubt
videos.overview: Holden finds himself at odds with his crew when a controversial decision is uncovered. On Ceres, Avasarala struggles to contain an escalating humanitarian crisis. Drummer's growing faction stage a daring raid with dire stakes. Filip, demoted to repair skiff duty, makes an unexpected discovery.

videos.title: Why We Fight
videos.overview: Paths converge on Ceres when Drummer and her fleet arrive to aid the relief effort. Holden tries to convince Avasarala to release crucial information that might avert catastrophe, but she has her own request of him. As Amos and Bobbie get a little R&R at the station, Naomi has a difficult and long-awaited reunion.

videos.title: Babylon's Ashes
videos.overview: In the thrilling season finale, Inners and Belters fight side by side with the crew of the Rocinante in a last, massive, desperate battle with Marco and his Free Navy, with the fate of the Solar System, the Ring Gates, and of all humanity hanging in the balance.
